scoring_breakdown.desktop_copy: 0.5 - A vlcsnap PNG file exists on the Desktop

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the GNOME desktop wallpaper URI using 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri', which is the standard method for GNOME.
Getter correctly strips surrounding quotes from the gsettings output before returning the URI.
Getter correctly counts VLC snapshot files on the Desktop using 'ls /home/user/Desktop/vlcsnap-*.png | wc -l', matching VLC's standard naming convention.
Metric correctly awards 0.5 for sub-goal 1 (wallpaper URI contains 'vlcsnap' and has a valid file URI scheme) and 0.5 for sub-goal 2 (at least one vlcsnap PNG on Desktop).
Partial credit structure aligns with the two independent sub-goals in the instruction.
Negative-control resistance is solid: initial state has neither a vlcsnap wallpaper nor Desktop copy, so it scores 0.0.
The evaluator checks ALL requirements stated in the instruction: (1) snapshot set as wallpaper and (2) copy placed on the Desktop.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: also check 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri-dark' in case the system is running in dark mode and only that key was updated; could average or take max of both URIs.
